plausibility_notes: Many guests now admit reception access; direct glass handling, bottle knowledge, and deliberate staffing interruption distinguish the strongest investigative targets.
A clear accusation is still premature because neither theft timing nor poison residue has been tied to one character.
Tess's late arrival is the first meaningful exclusion clue, conditional on the stolen original being the only poison source.
The dense series of confessions is readable individually but makes chronology difficult to retain across 22 people.
